# Prevent duplicate profile entries when the same resume is reviewed again

## What & Why
Saving the same reviewed resume more than once currently appends another copy of accepted links, skills, projects, experience, and education. Deduplication would keep the local assist profile useful when a reviewer reopens a resume to correct one proposal.

## Done looks like
- Re-reviewing the same accepted resume updates or preserves the existing structured entries instead of duplicating them.
- New or edited proposal values remain authoritative without removing unrelated user-entered entries.
- Repeated saves are covered by library and browser persistence tests.
